fact.label: Vehicle warranty
fact.scope: Kia Australia private-buyer policy baseline for explicitly enumerated applicable versions; actual model-year, commercial-use and component exceptions retained
qualifications: Private-use baseline. Commercial use at any time, including rental, hire, taxi, rideshare, courier, driving-school, security, bus or tour use, is limited to 7 years / 150,000 km, whichever occurs first.
Non-battery high-voltage components including on-board charger, traction motor and electric power-control unit: 7 years / 150,000 km. High-voltage battery has its separate model-year-specific policy.
Original 12 V battery: 2 years unlimited km. AV/AVN head unit: 3 years unlimited km. Paint appearance: 1 year; refrigerant charge: 1 year except covered repairs; tyres use supplier warranties.

Starts from recorded retail delivery, first registration or first commercial use, whichever occurs first. Western Australian dealer demonstrators have the stated purchase-date exception; used demonstrator mileage still counts.

Applies to vehicles sold by authorised Kia dealers, registered and operated in mainland Australia and Tasmania; remaining warranty transfers with vehicle. Normal wear, maintenance, misuse, accident damage and defects attributable to modifications or non-genuine parts are excluded; statutory consumer rights remain.

gradeReview.reason: Current Kia Australia warranty policy explicitly confirms the private-use baseline; real commercial and component exceptions are retained without downgrading that baseline.
